receiving_validation_inputs_proposal: Record actual manufacturer,SKU/finish and count against24 B104ZN+12 B103ZN. Keep bolt/nut/washer purchases separate unless the delivered contents are known.

Record actual steel thickness, both leg extents, width, every factory hole diameter/center/empty-hole edge ligament, angle,inside/outside heel and start of flat legs against the frozen nominal targets. The catalogue gives no guaranteed dimensional minima/tolerances for these checks.

Use actual minimum thickness/heel/hole datums in the unchanged component methods before promoting any nominal first-yield result; do not treat a quarter-inch SKU field as a verified section or an automatic strength correction.

An incompatible delivered fitting requires a reported layout/material-input correction before modifying wood holes or reviewed geometry. The current catalogue and SKU conflicts are unresolved inputs, not proof that any delivered fitting fails.

Retain own-member bearing/thread intervals, actual body/root sections,Fu,Fyb,washer material/bearing footprints,contact/heel/hole behavior and complete failure modes as separate joint inputs. No Eaton channel rating closes them.
